description: List exchange-traded funds matching filters such as category group, category, family (issuer), currency and exchange, or matching a free-text query on symbol or name. Every filter accepts one value or several comma-separated values. Use show_options('etfs', '<field>') to see valid filter values.

category.description: Category, e.g. 'Large Cap', 'Bonds', 'Technology' or 'Emerging Markets'. Several values: comma-separated (e.g. 'A, B') or a list. Case-insensitive.
category.title: Category

category_group.description: Broad category group, e.g. 'Equities', 'Fixed Income', 'Commodities' or 'Information Technology'. Several values: comma-separated (e.g. 'A, B') or a list. Case-insensitive.
category_group.title: Category Group

currency.description: Trading currency as an ISO code, e.g. 'USD' or 'EUR'. Several values: comma-separated (e.g. 'A, B') or a list. Case-insensitive.
currency.title: Currency

exchange.description: Exchange code, e.g. 'NMS' (NASDAQ Global Select), 'NYQ' (NYSE), 'PNK' (OTC Markets) or 'AMS' (Euronext Amsterdam). Use it to find an instrument's listings on certain exchanges, e.g. query='ASML' with exchange='NMS,NYQ,PNK' for its US listings. Several values: comma-separated (e.g. 'A, B') or a list. Case-insensitive.
exchange.title: Exchange

family.description: Fund family (issuer), e.g. 'BlackRock Asset Management' or 'Vanguard Asset Management'. Use show_options to find the exact name. Several values: comma-separated (e.g. 'A, B') or a list. Case-insensitive.
family.title: Family

include_delisted.description: Include delisted entries (excluded by default). Adds a `delisted` column.
include_delisted.title: Include Delisted

include_summary.description: Add the business/fund description (truncated to 300 characters). Off by default to keep responses small.
include_summary.title: Include Summary

mic.description: ISO 10383 market identifier code, e.g. 'XNAS', 'XNYS' or 'XAMS'. Several values: comma-separated (e.g. 'A, B') or a list. Case-insensitive.
mic.title: Mic

offset.description: Rows to skip, for paging (see the `_notes` hint in the response).
offset.title: Offset

only_primary_listing.description: Only primary listings: per instrument its listing on the main exchange of its home market (ASML.AS for ASML), or without one its listing on the largest main exchange abroad. Leaves out cross-listings, over-the-counter lines and depositary receipts.
only_primary_listing.title: Only Primary Listing

query.description: Optional free-text search on symbol and name (case-insensitive substring, e.g. 'apple' or 'AAPL'); an ISIN also matches where available. Best matches come first.
query.title: Query

show_columns.description: Columns to return, comma-separated. Default: symbol, name, currency, category_group, category, family, exchange. Available: symbol, name, currency, summary, category_group, category, family, exchange, mic, isin, delisted.
show_columns.title: Show Columns

name: etfs
